posts.title: Banana, cucumber, and a better computer

blocks.text: Turns out I can't screen record and generate video at the same time, or everything crashes. Honestly, I need a better computer. I'm also approving content that's 90% done, last-mile edits on videos and articles. Then comes banana cucumber, my feedback game: I scroll the site, say banana, talk through what to change, say cucumber, and it grabs a screenshot from anywhere in between. The clock only ticks down while I'm recording, so I subtract the editing time by hand. Hurrah.

posts.title: 36 sequences, and who goes into which one
Teaching a machine to sound like me
Label every piece before you build a page

blocks.text: I've always had trouble putting websites together, so last night I labelled every chunk of content: my LinkedIn posts, your team's, your website, hours and hours of transcripts. Then I could say: I hate the structure, give me three versions, and build a story that makes sense for each page. It did a really good job, and it's actually new, so I'll be using it after this. About 25 euros of build so far; the goal is a couple of euros a piece, for something that makes whoever gets it think they're your top account. This is what outreach looks like in 2026.
